Important: Drone and Heavy Drone share one shape; Frigate and Assault Frigate share another. In contact tests all twelve symbol choices and all five IFF choices remain visible on every question, including Battlecruiser and Battleship. An icon identifies a contact family, not necessarily its exact class or capabilities. The test recolours the supplied SVG geometry (with transparency preserved) for recognition practice; a grey unscanned contact would still require an actual scan to establish its class. IFF training convention: Yellow indicates UVP in this programme, replacing the original manual's Unknown classification. Mission-specific faction colours may differ; check the Radar readout.

Source and accuracy

Ship and station symbols use the original SVGs supplied by the UCN Academy. Torpedo, HVLI, Nuke, EMP and Mine use the supplied original SVGs. The mine artwork preserves the provided vector geometry and uses a light-grey display tint for legibility. IFF colour cards are faithful solid-colour samples of Figure 3-6 (printed page 25). Listed reference hull, shield and speed values for existing ship entries are from the manual. The deck contains twelve distinct contact icons (including UCN Carrier, UVP UCN Carrier, UVP Carrier and Small Station), five ordnance symbols and five IFF statuses. Colour associations are the Academy default and are not guaranteed in every mission. Ship questions require both contact classification and IFF. Ordnance questions require identification of the munition only; no IFF applies. Timed tests measure identification time, not actual Radar scanning performance.
